scope: Purge obsolete label functions, consolidate data label manipulation into updateChart, and fix clearCharts parameter handling

tasks.title: Purge getChartLabel, setChartLabel, and updateChartLabel Methods
tasks.description: Remove getChartLabel, setChartLabel, and updateChartLabel from src/elements/ChartManager.js, src/core/PPTXTemplater.js, and index.d.ts. Verify that all data label functionality (such as showVal, showCatName, showPercent, position, and label formatting) is consolidated and configurable via updateChart(chartId, { labels: { ... } }). Purge references to the deleted label methods from tests, documentation, and showcase files.

tasks.title: Fix clearCharts Signature and Error Handling When Passing chartId
tasks.description: Fix clearCharts in ChartManager.js and PPTXTemplater.js to prevent runtime exceptions when an argument is passed: (1) Accept polymorphic parameters clearCharts(slideRefOrChartId), (2) If a specific chartId is supplied, seamlessly delegate to removeChart(chartId) or evacuate that target chart cleanly, (3) If called with no argument or with a slide identifier, evacuate all charts from the target or active slide, (4) Ensure slide graphic frames, slide relationships (.rels), chart XML parts, and embedded workbooks are cleaned up without throwing errors or corrupting presentation state.

tasks.title: Update Documentation, .agent Workspace, and Integration Tests
tasks.description: Update docs-site/src/data/apiReference.json, docs-site/src/data/features.json, README.md, .agent/rules/features.md, and .agent/project_summary.md to reflect the locked 8-function Charts API whitelist. Update showcase/charts_operations.js and integration test suites to verify that clearCharts works with and without chartId/slide parameters without error.
